"'''The Ring'''" was the local name for a [[Black dwarf/Legends|black dwarf]]&ndash;type [[Star/Legends|compact star]]<ref name="GG" /> located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], a part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was surrounded by highly ionized, [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]].<ref name="GG" />

Eons before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a star exploded<ref name="GG" /> in a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="TEA" /> The remnants of the star decayed into what ultimately became the Ring, and the explosion also created the [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]]&mdash;a pair of vast [[Nebula/Legends|clouds]] of gas and dust that were eventually named the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax]] and [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebulae]] but were technically a single irregular nebula. The Ring itself was situated within the Ivax Nebula.<ref name="GG" />

After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing the Ring was re-designated as the Anoat sector.<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ring was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the black dwarf in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
